macos_font_stack: Segoe UI Variable Text, Inter, Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei UI, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
default_font_stack: Segoe UI, Microsoft YaHei UI, PingFang SC, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
license_note: No font binary is shipped. Both stacks name system-installed families (Segoe UI / Microsoft YaHei UI / PingFang SC / Noto Sans CJK SC) plus Inter (SIL OFL 1.1) as an optional fallback; sans-serif is the final fallback. Redistribution therefore adds no commercial or system font payload.
